sections.headingText: # VP of Growth Marketing — Apex Global Software

sections.rawContent: Apex Global Software is an enterprise B2B SaaS platform providing supply chain intelligence to Fortune 500 manufacturers across North America and Europe.

- Own and allocate the $4.5M annual performance marketing acquisition budget across digital channels, enterprise events, and paid search.
- Note: This role does not have company P&L ownership, which resides strictly with the General Manager and BU President.
- Build and optimize multi-channel lead acquisition funnels to deliver qualified pipeline for the enterprise sales team.
- Lead a high-performing digital marketing team of 6 growth specialists.

- 10+ years of digital demand generation and performance marketing experience in enterprise B2B SaaS.
- Demonstrated expertise in marketing budget allocation, pipeline attribution, and ROAS optimization.
